test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Khayal singers of 19th century was given the title of ‘Tanras” by Bahadur Shah Jaffar, the last Mughal Emperor of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Meer Qutub Baksh__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__**Meer Qutub Baksh**__

__
 
• **Meer Qutub Baksh** alias **'Tanrus Khan**' was an iconic **Khayal singer of the 19th century.**
 
• He was an** Indian musician** of the Hindustani Classical tradition known for being a luminary of the** Delhi Gharana.**
 
• He was a** court musician** and** music teacher** to **the last Mughal emperor Bahadur Shah Zafar II.**
 
• Tanrus Khan was famous for his swift, sparkling Taans and so the title **'Tanrus' (one who has a charming Taan) **was given to him by Bahadur Shah Zafar II, the last Mughal emperor.
 
• Occasionally Tanrus Khan sang **qawwalis** also.
 
• So he is also said to be a member of the** 'Qawwal Bachchon Ka Delhi Gharana'** originally organized by the legendary 13th-century musician **Amir Khusrow. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__**Bade Ustad Ghulam Ali Khan**__

__
 
• **Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan** was an Indian** Hindustani classical vocalist**, from the **Patiala gharana.**
 
• Bade Ghulam amalgamated the best of three traditions into his own Patiala-Kasur style:
 
 
• **The Behram Khani elements of Dhrupad **
 
• **The gyrations of Jaipur **
 
• **The behlavas of Gwalior.**
 
 
 
• He received **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1962.**

**Ustad Amir Khan**__

__
 
• **Ustad Amir Khan** was one of the greatest and most influential** Indian vocalists in the Hindustani classical tradition.**
 
• He was the** founder of the Indore Gharana.**
 
• Although his singing style was an amalgamation of** Kirana** and **Bhendibazaar Gharanas**.
 
• He was a virtually **self-taught musician.**
 
• He developed his own gayaki influenced by the styles of** Abdul Waheed Khan, Rajab Ali Khan, and Aman Ali Khan**.

**Sadarang**__

 
• **Sadarang** was the** pen name of the Hindustani musical composer and artist Naimat Khan.**
 
• He was active in the eighteenth century.
 
• He and his nephew** Adarang** changed the Khayal style of Hindustani music into the form performed today.
 
• Naimat Khan composed Khyal for his disciples and he never performed Khyal.
 
• Sadarang served in the court of** Mughal Emperor Muhammad Shah.**
 
• Sadarang and Adarang remain influential in Hindustani classical music, mainly through their compositions.
